lead: A user's picture. When the image fails to load or none is given, the fallback is shown; the loading state comes from Base UI's Avatar.

group.title: Avatar Group
group.description: Avatars stack, and those beyond `max` collapse into "+N". The group is `role=group`, and "+N" is a named `role=img`.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `avatar.css`; the corner radius comes from `--_r` in the size step.
styling.avatar-group: The stacking container; avatars inside are stacked with sibling selectors, and "+N" is an avatar with `data-overflow`
styling.avatar-fallback: Fallback content, shown when the image hasn't loaded
